Marigold, her little daughter, aged eleven, was seated at a corner of the square table that stood in the middle of the sitting-room, so engrossed in the story-book she was reading that she failed to grasp the sense of her mother's request, and looked up inquiringly.

arxiv-2002-05963.title: Toward Agile Situated Visualization: An Exploratory User Study
arxiv-2002-05963.creator: Leonel Merino Alexandre Bergel Boris Sotomayor-Gómez Michael Sedlmair Xingyao Yu Daniel Weiskopf Ronie Salgado
arxiv-2002-05963.description: Abstract We introduce AVAR , a prototypical implementation of an agile situated visualization (SV) toolkit targeting liveness, integration, and expressiveness. We report on results of an exploratory study with AVAR and seven expert users. In it, participants wore a Microsoft HoloLens device and used a Bluetooth keyboard to program a visualization script for a given dataset.

arxiv-2210-09865.title: Revealing the effects of curvature on the cosmological models
arxiv-2210-09865.creator: Weiqiang Yang, William Giarè, Supriya Pan, Eleonora Di Valentino, Alessandro Melchiorri, Joseph Silk
arxiv-2210-09865.description: Abstract In this paper we consider the effects of adding curvature in extended cosmologies involving a free-to-vary neutrino sector and different parametrizations of Dark Energy (DE). We make use of the Planck 2018 cosmic microwave background temperature and polarization data, Baryon Acoustic Oscillations and Pantheon type Ia Supernovae data.

arxiv-2309-03334.title: The 4-intersection unprojection format
arxiv-2309-03334.creator: Vasiliki Petrotou
arxiv-2309-03334.description: Abstract . Unprojection theory is a philosophy due to Miles Reid, which becomes a useful tool in algebraic geometry for the construction and the study of new interesting geometric objects such as algebraic surfaces and 3-folds. In this present work we introduce a new format of unprojection, which we call the 4-intersection format.

arxiv-2312-05787.title: Efficient Sparse-Reward Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning with a High Replay Ratio and Regularization
arxiv-2312-05787.creator: Takuya Hiraoka takuya-h1@nec.com NEC Corporation National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology
arxiv-2312-05787.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning (RL) methods with a high replay ratio (RR) and regularization have gained interest due to their superior sample efficiency. However, these methods have mainly been developed for dense-reward tasks. In this paper, we aim to extend these RL methods to sparse-reward goal-conditioned tasks. We use Randomized Ensemble Double Q-learning (REDQ) ( Chen et al.

arxiv-2412-05964.title: A Cross-Validation Study of Turkish Sentiment Analysis Datasets and Tools
arxiv-2412-05964.creator: Şevval Çakıcı Dilara Karaduman sevval.cakici@ozu.edu.tr dkaraduman17@ku.edu.tr Ozyegin University Koc University Mehmet Akif Çırlan Ali Hürriyetoğlu mcirlan19@ku.edu.tr ali.hurriyetoglu@wur.nl Koc University Wageningen Food Safety Research
arxiv-2412-05964.description: Abstract In recent years, sentiment analysis has gained increasing significance, prompting researchers to explore datasets in various languages, including Turkish. However, the limited availability of Turkish datasets has led to their multifaceted usage in different studies, yielding diverse outcomes. To overcome this challenge, a rigorous review was conducted of research articles published between 2012 and 2022.

arxiv-2412-17286.title: The Unique Helium Nova V445 Puppis Ejected ≫ \gg 0.001 M ⊙ in the Year 2000 and Will Not Become a Type Ia Supernova Facilities: DASCH, ZTF, APASS, AAVSO, TESS
arxiv-2412-17286.creator: Bradley E. Schaefer
arxiv-2412-17286.description: Abstract V445 Puppis is the only known example of a helium nova, where a layer of helium-rich gas accretes onto the surface of a white dwarf in a cataclysmic variable, with runaway helium burning making for the nova event. Speculatively, helium nova can provide one path to produce a Type Ia supernova (SNIa), within the larger framework of single-degenerate models.

plos-pone-0002353.title: Adenosine Transporter ENT4 Is a Direct Target of EWS/WT1 Translocation Product and Is Highly Expressed in Desmoplastic Small Round Cell Tumor
plos-pone-0002353.creator: Hongjie Li, Gromoslaw A. Smolen, Lisa F. Beers et al.
plos-pone-0002353.description: PLOS ONE research article. Desmoplastic Small Round Cell Tumor (DSRCT) is a highly aggressive malignancy that affects mainly adolescents and young adults. pmc-10650198.title: Grappling with Issues of Motherhood for Women with Schizophrenia
pmc-10650198.creator: Mary V Seeman, Axel Steiger
pmc-10650198.description: Despite the fact that most persons with schizophrenia find steady employment difficult to sustain, many women with this diagnosis embrace and fulfill the most difficult task of all—motherhood. The aim of this paper is to specify the challenges of motherhood in this population and review the treatment strategies needed to keep mothers and children safe, protecting health and fostering growth.

pmc-10666087.title: BINOL as a Chiral Solvating Agent for Sulfiniminoboronic Acids
pmc-10666087.creator: Robin
pmc-10666087.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). 1H NMR spectroscopic studies using BINOL as a chiral solvating agent (CSA) for a scalemic sulfiniminoboronic acid (SIBA) have revealed concentration- and enantiopurity-dependent variations in the chemical shifts of diagnostic imine protons used to determine enantiopurity levels. 11B/15N NMR spectroscopic studies and X-ray structural investigations revealed that unlike other iminoboronate species, BINOL–SIBA assemblies do not contain N–B coordination bonds, with 1H NMR NOESY experiments indicating that intermolecular H-bonding networks between BINOL and the SIBA analyte are responsible for these variations.

pmc-11491068.title: ETS1 Expression in Diabetic Foot Ulcers: Implications for Fibroblast Phenotype and Wound Healing Through the PP2A/YAP Pathway
pmc-11491068.creator: Wenjuan Yi, Qionglin Bao, Dingkun Xu, Chenyu Long, Ruixin Fang, Wenlin Cheng, Jiquan Song, Huiting Feng
pmc-11491068.description: ObjectiveDiabetic foot ulcers (DFUs) are a serious complication of diabetes, characterized by impaired wound healing and high morbidity and mortality risks. While ETS1 is known to influence fibroblast pathological remodeling, its specific role in DFU and fibroblast wound healing remains unclear.MethodsSkin tissue samples from DFU patients were categorized by Wagner grades to analyze ETS1 expression.

pmc-11671824.title: Molecular Tracking of Leishmania major in an Archived Rattus norvegicus Spleen Sample in Iran: A Case Report
pmc-11671824.creator: Mahya Allahmoradi, Faezeh Najafi, Mona Koosha, Elham Kazemirad, Alireza Latifi, Saied Reza Naddaf, Hamed Mirjalali, Mehdi Mohebali, Homa Hajjaran, Domenico Otranto, Gholamreza Mowlavi
pmc-11671824.description: Rodents are the primary reservoir hosts for zoonotic cutaneous leishmaniasis (ZCL) caused by Leishmania major. Knowing reservoir hosts is crucial for leishmaniasis surveillance and control programs in endemic areas. In this study, we examined an archived spleen of Rattus norvegicus obtained during a pest control program in 2000 in Tehran, the capital of Iran.

pmc-12451355.title: Resource use and in-hospital costs after aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage in the Netherlands
pmc-12451355.creator: FP Mulder, JTJM van Dijck, RJG Vreeburg, C Engels, WA Moojen
pmc-12451355.description: IntroductionAneurysmal Subarachnoid Hemorrhage (aSAH) is a severe condition requiring advanced interventions and intensive in-hospital care. The associated financial burden challenges resource allocation and healthcare sustainability.Research questionThis study aimed to evaluate the in-hospital healthcare consumption and costs for patients hospitalised with aSAH.

pmc-12716827.title: Direct-to-Consumer Teledermatology for Male Androgenetic Alopecia: Narrative Review
pmc-12716827.creator: Finn Abeck, Inga Hansen-Abeck, Julian Kött, Edward Garrahy, Stefan W Schneider, Johannes von Büren
pmc-12716827.description: This narrative review examines the advantages and disadvantages of direct-to-consumer teledermatology for the treatment of male androgenetic alopecia, finding that this treatment modality improves access to care, ensures high adherence rates, and enhances patient satisfaction, while raising concerns about increased drug costs. Introduction Androgenetic alopecia (AA) is the most common form of hair loss [1].

pmc-12834501.title: Structural characterisation of chromatin remodelling intermediates supports linker DNA-dependent product inhibition as a mechanism for nucleosome spacing
pmc-12834501.creator: Amanda L Hughes, Ramasubramanian Sundaramoorthy, Tom Owen-Hughes, Geeta J Narlikar
pmc-12834501.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Previously, we showed that Saccharomyces cerevisiae Chd1 chromatin remodelling enzyme associates with nucleosomes oriented towards the longer linker (Sundaramoorthy et al., 2018) (1). Here, we report a series of structures of Chd1 bound to nucleosomes during ongoing ATP-dependent repositioning. Combining these with biochemical experiments and existing literature, we propose a model in which Chd1 first associates oriented to sample putative entry DNA.

pmc-13088569.title: Haplotype-based genome-wide association study uncovers QTL for fruit-related traits in the 287 tomato accessions
pmc-13088569.creator: Tuong Tuyet Nhung Nguyen, Jaehun Heo, Byounghwan Lim, Sung-Chur Sim
pmc-13088569.description: BackgroundGenome-wide association study (GWAS) is a strategy for genetic dissection of quantitative traits with high mapping resolution. Haplotypes based on multiple SNPs provide an effective alternative for exploring loci associated with complex quantitative traits. In this study, haplotype-based GWAS (Hap-GWAS) was conducted for seven fruit-related traits in the 287 tomato accessions, consisting of 237 S. lycopersicum, 30 S. lycopersicum var.
